package_contents: typing marker and license present; wheel excludes evaluation data; sdist excludes caches and virtualenv

usage: proseprobe check [-h] [--select SELECT]
                        [--profile {academic,business,general,journalism,technical-docs}]
                        [--ignore IGNORE] [--config CONFIG]
                        [--severity {error,warning,info}]
                        [--min-confidence {high,medium,low}] [--hide-low]
                        [--baseline BASELINE] [--quiet] [--verbose]
                        [--filename FILENAME] [--show-config]
                        [--format {text,json,jsonl,sarif}]
                        [--generate-baseline]
                        paths [paths ...]

positional arguments:
  paths                 Files or directories to check

options:
  -h, --help            Show this help message and exit
  --select SELECT, -s SELECT
                        Rules to enable (comma-separated)
  --profile {academic,business,general,journalism,technical-docs}
                        Built-in rule profile
  --ignore IGNORE, -i IGNORE
                        Rules to disable (comma-separated)
  --config CONFIG, -c CONFIG
                        Path to configuration file
  --severity {error,warning,info}
                        Minimum severity: error, warning, info
  --min-confidence {high,medium,low}
                        Minimum confidence: high, medium, low
  --hide-low            Hide low-confidence issues (shorthand for --min-
                        confidence medium)
  --baseline BASELINE, -b BASELINE
                        Baseline file for only-new-issues mode
  --quiet, -q           Only output errors
  --verbose, -v         Show additional diagnostic info
  --filename FILENAME   Virtual path and file type when reading standard input
                        from '-'
  --show-config         Display configuration and exit
  --format {text,json,jsonl,sarif}, -f {text,json,jsonl,sarif}
                        Output format: text, json, jsonl, sarif
  --generate-baseline   Generate baseline file from current issues
